- **Realtime CVol.** Implemented realtime CVol (VIX-like) index pricing using OTM option

- Proposed a new `enum` framework that uses SFINAE and TMP to generate `enumToString` and

<details>
<summary>**Quantitative Engineer, Goldman Sachs** &mdash; Sep 2024&ndash;Feb 2026, London, UK</summary>

- **Gap Risk (MPoR):** Extended the macro desk CVA engine to support Gap Risk (MPoR) by

- Implemented the impact of Initial Margin (IM), conservatively excluding
  counterparty-posted IM and modeling GS-posted, credit-risky portions as uncollateralized

- **MTA impacts to CVA:** Modeled the impact of Minimum Transfer Amounts (MTA) on CVA by
  forking the residual exposure calculation and using a dense 5-day simulation grid to
